subject: Anchored roll‑forward pricing and unbundling options
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <s.grant@carelytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carelytics.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchored roll‑forward pricing and unbundling options

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, CareLytics is heading into a renewal window and wants clarity on two things before the exec sign‑off:

1) A roll‑forward (one‑time) credit path that preserves existing committed capacity while allowing you to change the feature mix.
2) The ability to unbundle a small subset of premium features (advanced routing, per‑token debug traces) so you only pay for them on demand.

Quick answers up front: we can support a constrained roll‑forward (one quarter window) and we can put the premium features on a usage add‑on. What I need from you is the target commit (tokens/month) and whether the procurement team needs an anchored discount expressed as a flat % or a stepped schedule.

Next steps I suggest:
- If procurement wants an "anchor" discount we can offer a 12% anchor if CareLytics signs a 12‑month commit at >= current committed tokens.
- Alternatively, a stepped anchor: 8% at sign, +4% at the 6‑month usage milestone.

I've attached a mutual action plan that maps milestones and can be turned into a SOW amendment. I looped in procurement per your ask.

Available for a 30 min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | (415) 555‑0119

Attachments: Carelytics_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sophie Grant <s.grant@carelytics.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carelytics.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored roll‑forward pricing and unbundling options

Hi Lauren —

Thanks — quick clarifiers from procurement:
- We expect to maintain the same committed tokens/month but want the ability to shift 20% of spend from the base plan into feature add‑ons after month 3 (trial of new analytics pipeline). Is that feasible?
- For the anchor, procurement prefers a stepped approach (shows executive progress). Can you put the stepped anchor in writing with clear milestone triggers?
- Pricing team also asked if the premium feature unbundle can be metered (per‑call) rather than a monthly seat.

If you can send a short mark that shows: baseline commit, stepped anchor % and the per‑call rate for premium features we can route to legal & finance.

Sophie
Head of Product Operations | CareLytics
s.grant@carelytics.com

Karthik / Ben —

Looping you in. CareLytics (deal CL‑2026‑139) is asking for:
- Stepped anchor % (procurement wants stepped schedule).
- Ability to shift ~20% of committed spend into add‑ons after month 3.
- Metered per‑call pricing for two premium features: advanced routing & per‑token debug traces.

Can you advise on:
1) Recommended stepped anchor (numbers and milestone triggers).
2) Per‑call math (unit, rounding, expected effective CPM).
3) Any constraint on roll‑forward window length (we discussed one quarter).

If we can pivot to a 12 month commit with guardrails we may be able to protect ARR while giving CareLytics flexibility. Attaching the MAP they have.

—Lauren

Attachment: Carelytics_MutualActionPlan.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Anchored roll‑forward pricing and unbundling options — pricing help needed

Lauren —

Draft recommendation below (aiming to balance ACV protection and flexibility):

Proposed stepped anchor (example for current commit = 1B tokens/month):
- Anchor offer A (stepped): 8% discount at sign for 12‑month commit; additional 4% (total 12%) after cumulative usage >= 50% of expected volume by month 6.
- If they elect roll‑forward within quarter window, limit to 20% of total token capacity to be re‑allocated to add‑ons. Any further change triggers a re‑quote.

Add‑on metering (recommended):
- Advanced routing: $0.00035 per routed request (rounded to nearest 1000 reqs) — est. effective CPM $0.60 at current call profile.
- Per‑token debug traces: $0.0009 per traced token (metered on toggles) — useful as on/off during debugging windows.

Operational constraints:
- Roll‑forward window: 90 days from contract effective date. Changes allowed once during window.
- MAP table should include a trial clause: first 30 days, unbundled features at 50% metered rate to validate.

If we need to be more aggressive on discount we can trade on a 24‑month commit and increase anchor to 14% at sign, +3% at month 6.

Happy to convert to a short PDF. Also recommend DocuSign for the amendment to capture the stepped milestone language.

—Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <s.grant@carelytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@carelytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored roll‑forward pricing and unbundling options

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the clear asks. Based on internal alignment we can do the stepped anchor you requested. Summary below (short mark for finance/legal):

Summary offer (short mark):
- Baseline: maintain current committed tokens (1B tokens/month indicated).
- Stepped anchor: 8% discount at signature (12‑month commit), additional 4% (total 12%) when cumulative usage >= 50% of expected volume by month 6.
- Roll‑forward: 90‑day window from contract effective date; one‑time re‑allocation up to 20% of committed capacity into add‑ons.
- Premium feature metering:
  • Advanced routing: $0.00035 per routed request (billed monthly; rounded to 1,000 request increments).
  • Per‑token debug trace: $0.0009 per traced token; toggleable, billed by trace token.
- Trial clause: first 30 days of add‑on usage at 50% of the metered rate to validate pipeline.

Attachments: short PDF mark with the stepped anchor and a draft MAP have been attached to the HubSpot deal. DocuSign link for the amendment will be sent once you confirm the numbers.

Would you like us to:
- Send a formal short mark for legal (PDF + amendment language) — I can follow with DocuSign.
- Or, schedule a 25 min joint call with finance & procurement to walk the schedule?

If procurement is comfortable, we can move the mark to legal this week.

Thanks — speak soon.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
